        <commentText>This Amendment No. 23 to Schedule 13D (this "Amendment") relates to shares of common stock, par value $0.01 per share ("Common Stock"), of Hilltop Holdings Inc., a Maryland corporation ("Hilltop"). This Amendment amends the Schedule 13D, as previously amended, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") by Gerald J. Ford, a United States citizen, Diamond A Financial, L.P., a Texas limited partnership ("Financial LP"), Diamond HTH Stock Company, LP, a Texas limited partnership, Diamond HTH Stock Company GP, LLC, a Texas limited liability company, and Turtle Creek Revocable Trust (collectively, the "Reporting Persons") by furnishing the information set forth below. Except as otherwise specified in this Amendment, all previous Items are unchanged. Capitalized terms used herein and not defined herein have the meanings given to them in the Schedule 13D, as previously amended, filed with the SEC.</commentText>
      </item1>
      <item4>
        <transactionPurpose>Item 4 is hereby amended and supplemented as follows: On October 16, 2026, counsel to Gerald J. Ford delivered a letter (the "Letter") to the Board of Directors of Hilltop Holdings Inc. (the "Board"), a copy of which is filed as Exhibit 99.B to this Schedule 13D and is incorporated herein by reference. In the Letter, Mr. Ford raised concerns regarding the Company's current corporate governance arising from Jeremy Ford's simultaneous service as the Company's President/Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of the Board while also serving as plaintiff in pending litigation against Mr. Ford. Mr. Ford stated that, under the circumstances described in the Letter, the Company should, at a minimum, promptly split the President/Chief Executive Officer and Chairman roles as a matter of sound corporate governance, and that the Company's appointment of a lead independent director is not a substitute for doing so. Mr. Ford requested that the Board promptly investigate the matters raised in the Letter. The Reporting Persons may engage in further discussions with the Board, management, other shareholders, or third parties regarding the matters described in the Letter and may take such other actions as they deem appropriate in furtherance of the foregoing, including proposing further changes to the Company's board composition, management, or governance practices. The information set forth in Item 6 of this Amendment is incorporated by reference into this Item 4.</transactionPurpose>
      </item4>
      <item5>
        <percentageOfClassSecurities>Item 5 is hereby amended and supplemented as follows:

(a)-(b) Each Reporting Person declares that neither the filing of this statement nor anything herein shall be construed as an admission that such person is, for the purposes of Section 13(d) or 13(g) of the Act or any other purpose, the beneficial owner of any securities covered by this statement.

Each Reporting Person may be deemed to be a member of a group with respect to Hilltop or securities of Hilltop for the purposes of Section 13(d) or 13(g) of the Act. Each Reporting Person declares that neither the filing of this statement nor anything herein shall be construed as an admission that such person is, for the purposes of Section 13(d) or 13(g) of the Act or any other purpose, (i) acting (or has agreed or is agreeing to act) with any other person as a partnership, limited partnership, syndicate, or other group for the purpose of acquiring, holding, or disposing of securities of Hilltop or otherwise with respect to Hilltop or any securities of Hilltop or (ii) a member of any syndicate or group with respect to Hilltop or any securities of Hilltop.
